name: dev-cli

# dev-cli

Git owns durable code; worktrees are local checkouts; runtimes are host-local
sessions; dev records task intent.

## Discover what you need

Use leaf `--help` for syntax, `dev help <topic>` for workflows, and
`dev help --tree` for families. See [navigation](references/command-navigation.md)
for shortcuts and Try graduation/demotion; dashboard details: `dev help tui`.
Prefer supported JSON. Read help before mutation: some actions apply immediately,
others require preview/apply. Do not preload manuals or run routine diagnostics.

## Preserve these boundaries

- Opening needs no task. Select direct, branch or worktree deliberately; use
  explicit `--base`. Managed worktrees stay outside repositories.
- Task-free worktrees use `dev git worktree create/open`; cleanup stays reviewed.
  `dev repo list --json` supplies navigation candidates, not external preferences/history.
- `dev work start` prepares checkout/runtime; agent launch is explicit. Parallel
  writers require disjoint ownership and verified targets.
- Completion, artifacts, retirement and branch deletion are separate. Finalize
  after writer exit; retire externally. Use `retire --base` when integration is unproven.
- Cached/unknown observations, runtime `done` and merged PRs never authorize
  cleanup. Resolve guards; never improvise force removal or bypass checks.
- `dev pr checkout <URL>` is task-free; `--try` creates an independent clone.
  Provisioning is explicit; merge never cleans up locally.

## Read a reference for advanced operations

- Worktrees/lifecycle: [ownership](references/worktree-ownership.md), [lifecycle](references/task-lifecycle.md).
- Agents/prompts: [agents](references/parallel-agents.md), [handoffs](references/prompt-handoffs.md).
- History retention, exact sessions and co-commit: [artifacts](references/ai-artifacts.md).
- Cleanup: [retirement](references/agent-retirement.md), [triage](references/local-triage.md).
- Hygiene/scans/redaction: [hygiene](references/hygiene.md).
- Forks/setup/organization: [setup](references/repository-bootstrap.md), [bootstrap](references/bootstrap.md).
- SSH/fleet: [SSH](references/ssh-hosts.md).
- Dotfile setup, native chezmoi operations, or FLEET host actions: [dotfiles](references/dotfiles.md).
- Skill/MCP/instruction transfers, updates or removal: [transfers](references/agent-interop.md), [maintenance](references/skills-management.md).
- [Snippets](references/snippets.md).
- PR/MR pages, diffnav, gh-dash, checkout and merge: [pull requests](references/pull-requests.md).
- Recursive Git children: [submodules](references/submodules.md).

## Unexpected dev failures

Read [feedback and repair](references/feedback-and-repair.md). Preserve the
original task; extra investigation, repair, subagents and publication need
explicit consent covering scope and cost.

- **Read windows**: packing (the heavy source read) can be blocked in given hours, e.g.
  `"Mon-Fri 09:15-15:30 Asia/Shanghai"`; uploads continue from staging.
- **Direct egress by default**: proxy variables are stripped from every backend process,

  fake-ip or routed via a tun interface fail the preflight. See *Egress* below.
- **Source deletion policy**: `never`, `after_remote_size` (as soon as the relay holds a
  byte-identical-size copy; for regenerable data) or `after_receiver_ack` (after the
  destination verified sha256).

## Documentation

Read the [English documentation](docs/index.md) for a safe local quickstart,
configuration reference, and operational guidance. The Zensical site is a local
pilot; GitHub Pages has not been enabled or published.

```bash
just docs-setup   # install the locked docs group alongside dev dependencies
just docs-build   # strict site build plus HTML/Markdown/LLM artifact checks
just docs-serve              # http://127.0.0.1:8000
just docs-serve 8769         # use another port if 8000 is occupied
just docs-serve 8769 0.0.0.0 # optional: expose preview on all interfaces
```

`docs-serve` takes an optional port followed by an optional host. Keep the
loopback default unless network access is intentional; binding `0.0.0.0` exposes
the preview to other hosts allowed by your firewall. Do not stop another service
just to reclaim port 8000.

Documentation tooling is not part of ferry's runtime dependencies.

## Install

```bash
uv tool install git+https://github.com/daviddwlee84/ferry   # CLI on PATH
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check the English all-pages artifact contract; never build or publish the site."""

import argparse
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import tomllib
from urllib.parse import unquote, urljoin, urlsplit


class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, text):
        super().__init__()
        self.copy_urls = []
        self.links = []
        self.feed(text)

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if "data-md-copy-url" in attrs:
            self.copy_urls.append(attrs["data-md-copy-url"])
        if tag == "a" and attrs.get("href"):
            self.links.append(attrs["href"])
        if tag == "img" and attrs.get("src"):
            self.links.append(attrs["src"])


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check(root):
    project = tomllib.loads((root / "zensical.toml").read_text())["project"]
    require(project.get("docs_dir", "docs") == "docs" and project.get("site_dir", "site") == "site",
            "this checker expects docs/ and site/; review it before changing output layout")
    require(project.get("theme", {}).get("language") == "en", "this pilot validates English content only")
    require(not project.get("hooks"), "MkDocs hooks are not supported by this pilot")
    plugins = project.get("plugins", {})
    require(not (set(plugins) - {"search", "llmstxt"}),
            "additional plugins need an explicit compatibility and artifact review")
    require(plugins.get("llmstxt", {}).get("full_output") == "llms-full.txt",
            "expected llmstxt.full_output = llms-full.txt")
    base = project["site_url"]
    require(base.endswith("/"), "site_url must end in /")
    origin = urlsplit(base)
    docs, site = root / "docs", root / "site"
    for directory in (docs, site):
        require(directory.is_dir() and not directory.is_symlink(), f"missing or symlinked {directory.name}/")
        require(not any(path.is_symlink() for path in directory.rglob("*")),
                f"{directory.name}/ contains symlinks")
    sources = sorted(docs.rglob("*.md"))
    require(sources and (docs / "index.md") in sources, "expected docs/index.md and Markdown pages")

    def local_file(url):
        parsed = urlsplit(url)
        require((parsed.scheme, parsed.netloc) == (origin.scheme, origin.netloc),
                f"artifact URL uses a different origin: {url}")
        require(parsed.path.startswith(origin.path), f"artifact URL drops the project subpath: {url}")
        relative = unquote(parsed.path[len(origin.path):])
        path = (site / relative).resolve()
        require(path.is_relative_to(site.resolve()), f"artifact URL escapes site/: {url}")
        if parsed.path.endswith("/"):
            path /= "index.html"
        require(path.is_file(), f"missing artifact for {url}")
        return path

    index = (site / "llms.txt").read_text()
    full = (site / "llms-full.txt").read_text()
    links = re.findall(r"^\s*-\s+\[.*?\]\(<?([^)>\s]+)>?\)", index, re.MULTILINE)
    exported = [local_file(link) for link in links]
    require(len(exported) == len(set(exported)), "duplicate pages in llms.txt")
    expected = set()
